text: Program Description Objectives: this major is to cultivate professional English talents who should have better and comprehensive language application ability, intercultural communication competence, technology transfer and language service ability, who should also make use of knowledge of the major to think, innovate and participate in scientific researches. Employability: graduates mainly engage in training, translation, business affairs, administrative management, oversea sales and other works in foreign trade, communication, IT and other industries, they also take up occupations in foreign companies and well-known domestic companies (Huawei, APL, Bank of China, China Mobile and Global 500 enterprises, for examples).
